system.title: System Information
system.subtitle: Complete overview of all data sources, connections, and architecture
system.archMonolith: Single Express process serves the built React SPA (static files from /dist) and all API endpoints. One container, one process, one port.
system.archAuth: Operators log in through the platform's Authentik using the OIDC authorization code flow with PKCE; digita-post keeps its own session in MongoDB and checks a CSRF header on every mutation. Internal callers (digita-engine, digita-auth) still authenticate with a digita-auth-signed service JWT, verified offline via JWKS.
system.whoPopulatesDesc: After every sendEmail() call, a fire-and-forget insertOne() writes the email log entry to this collection. The DB write never blocks email delivery.
system.dataSourceDnsSmtp: Data Source: DNS Lookups + SMTP Connection
system.authFlow: GET /api/auth/login redirects an unauthenticated operator to the platform's Authentik; GET /api/auth/callback exchanges the code, verifies the ID token and starts post's own session in a host-only httpOnly cookie with no Domain attribute. Every admin call is checked against that session in MongoDB, and a mutation also carries the session's CSRF token in the X-CSRF-Token header. POST /api/auth/logout ends the session and hands the SPA Authentik's own end-session URL to navigate to.
system.noUserDb: digita-post keeps no user profile database — an operator's identity (sub, email, name, preferred_username) comes from Authentik's ID token at login and is cached in the session document for the session's lifetime.
system.sessionNoRevocation: digita-post never checks back with Authentik once a session exists: an operator removed from the admins group keeps access until their post session expires, at most {seconds} seconds after login (POST_SESSION_TTL_SECONDS).
system.resendTrigger: Admin clicks 'Resend' on a failed email in the Email Logs page and optionally edits to, cc, subject.
